figure_groups.purpose: Read the retrieval baseline, contextual insertion and reported results as a connected explanation. Never transfer the reported values to another system.
Compare recovery information in a useful error and its negative contrast. E8 is not a style target.
Compare detailed and concise outputs by retained semantic information, not font size.

patterns.counterexample: Do not draw a causal arrow between merely correlated measurements.
patterns.rule: Name each handoff, preserve explicit nodes, and give feedback its own outside lane.
patterns.transfer: In a workshop intake, separate safety and parts review before coordination; keep human authority explicit.
patterns.use: A reader must distinguish separate work and the point where it rejoins.

patterns.counterexample: Do not align unrelated metrics as if they were a common benchmark.
patterns.rule: Align comparable rows; use the same scale and wording level across columns.
patterns.transfer: Compare routing and parallel work by the question each answers, without inventing speed differences.
patterns.use: Alternatives answer different questions or share decision criteria.

patterns.counterexample: Do not convert unknown values into negative judgments.
patterns.rule: Keep criterion order stable and label unknowns explicitly.
patterns.transfer: Map record classes against inclusion policy and next review action.
patterns.use: The reader must inspect several alternatives against the same criteria.

patterns.counterexample: Do not manufacture measurements to fill an attractive chart.
patterns.rule: Use a zero baseline, exact values and a data provenance note.
patterns.transfer: Show corpus coverage counts as index counts, never model performance.
patterns.use: Actual magnitudes share a unit and denominator.

patterns.counterexample: Do not imply continuity between arbitrary categories.
patterns.rule: Use increasing x values, declare both units and retain a complete readable data key.
patterns.transfer: A cumulative index traversal can use ordinal position, explicitly distinguished from time.
patterns.use: A numeric x axis has a meaningful order and measured or derived values.

patterns.counterexample: Do not let decorative size imply an unsupported quantity.
patterns.rule: Use distinct labeled motifs, restrained color and a visible conceptual label.
patterns.transfer: Introduce retrieval, inspection and creation without claiming automated review.
patterns.use: An opening metaphor introduces a conceptual progression.

status: Original design guidance; not an official Anthropic brand manual or a corpus visual analysis
